{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify no invalid entries remain
invalid_count = df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries after cleaning: {invalid_count}")

# Check the first few cleaned values
print("First 10 cleaned revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
